chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Meat builds meat, and whoever leaves meat for forty days, his character will worsen, and whoever has a worsened character, give the Adhan in his ear.
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of not eating meat for forty days according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith establishes a holistic link between physical sustenance and spiritual temperament, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the body as a vessel for moral character. The specific remedy of reciting the Adhan for those with deteriorated manners highlights the therapeutic power of divine remembrance in correcting behavioral flaws, a concept deeply rooted in Shia ascetic and medical traditions.
